title: 張

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩的房間場景，床頭上方或床頭邊有一張畫。畫本身可以是簡單圖案或風景，但畫上不可有文字、數字、簽名、標籤或水印。人物若出現要明確：主角小女孩。不可有文字、數字或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L253 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. In the recurring protagonist little girl's home bedroom, show the bed headboard and one framed picture above or beside the bed head. The picture contains only a simple landscape or abstract color shapes, with no readable text, no signature, no numbers, no labels. The recurring protagonist little girl from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip, may be in the room looking at the picture.
Approved semantic notes: 主角小女孩的房間場景，床頭上方或床頭邊有一張畫。畫本身可以是簡單圖案或風景，但畫上不可有文字、數字、簽名、標籤或水印。人物若出現要明確：主角小女孩。不可有文字、數字或標籤。
Style/medium: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration matching approved L058 style traits: soft transparent watercolor, delicate colored-pencil linework, warm natural light, bright clean palette, expressive preschool proportions, detailed but uncluttered environments. L058 is style reference only; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Composition: center bed headboard and exactly one visible picture with generous safe margins; phone-readable square crop.
Constraints: no written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, signatures, picture captions, logos, brands, watermarks, or readable marks anywhere.
